meta.name: get-unpublished-changes
meta.description: Compare HEAD with the latest published npm versions and list all unpublished changes by release layer. Triggers: unpublished changes, changelog, what changed, whats new.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 列出尚未发布的 npm 改动,按发布层级分组。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果想把本地改动与已发布版本对比,发布前心中有数。
copy.tagline_en: See what changed since the last published npm release.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to review unpublished changes before releasing.

howto.what: 它会对比当前代码与三个 npm 包最新发布版,读取真实 diff,按 omo pure components、omo opencode、omo codex 分层,输出未发布变更、影响矩阵与版本建议。
howto.when: 当你提到「unpublished changes」「changelog」等词,或问「what changed / whats new」时触发。

say.text: 看看有哪些未发布的更改
say.note: 它会对比最新 npm 版本并列出变更。

say.text: 生成按发布层分类的 changelog
say.note: 它会输出三层影响矩阵和版本建议。

say.text: 从上次发布到现在改了什么
say.note: 它读取 git diff 后给出真实改动说明。

howto.what_en: Compares HEAD with the latest published npm versions, reads the actual diffs, classifies changes into omo pure components / omo opencode / omo codex release layers, and outputs an unpublished-change list with impact matrix and version bump recommendations.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you mention 'unpublished changes', 'changelog', or ask 'what changed' / 'whats new'.

say_en.note: It compares with the latest npm version and lists changes.
It outputs the impact matrix and version recommendations.

say_en.text: What changed since the last publish?
say_en.note: It reads the git diff and describes real changes.
